svg.title: Known-best packing of 229 unit squares, regularized (prototype)
svg.desc: A regularized derived view of the known-best n=229 construction made by the grid-slack prototype, never the source witness. It changes no side, frontier value or evidence tier; the evidence stated is the record's.

sqpack:profile.sqpack:value: Complete 00e68df rational centre/half-angle dilation certificate read exactly from the retained source. Finite construction feasibility only; no KKT, local minimum, rigidity, novelty, priority or global optimality claim.
